definition.scope: Bounded local model; not the complete original school. Data availability and entry conditions are checked separately.
definition.scope_ar: نموذج محلي محدد القواعد؛ لا يمثل المدرسة الأصلية بكاملها. يجري فحص توفر البيانات وشروط الدخول بشكل منفصل.
rules: House rule: ATR-normalized square-root level shifted by 0.25 from a confirmed pivot; fresh cross within 32 bars with anchor intact.
rules_ar: قاعدة خاصة: مستوى جذر سعر معياري بنطاق التقلب وإزاحة ربع وحدة من محور مؤكد؛ عبور جديد خلال اثنتين وثلاثين شمعة مع سلامة المحور.

algorithm_python:
def root_grid(b,c):
    p=st._alternating_pivots(c["pivots"])
    if not p:return wait(b)
    anchor=p[-1];bull=anchor["kind"]=="LOW";unit=st.atr(b[:anchor["index"]+1])
    if unit<=0:return wait(b)
    root=math.sqrt(anchor["price"]/unit);shift=root+(.25 if bull else -.25)
    if shift<=0:return wait(b)
    level=unit*shift*shift
    age=len(b)-1-(anchor["index"]+2)
    intact=all(x["low"]>=anchor["price"] if bull else x["high"]<=anchor["price"] for x in b[anchor["index"]+1:])
    cross=b[-2]["close"]<=level<b[-1]["close"] if bull else b[-2]["close"]>=level>b[-1]["close"]
    active=1<=age<=32 and intact and cross
    result=signal(b,active and bull,active and not bull,anchor["price"],anchor["price"],{"level": level,"unit": unit,"anchor": anchor,"age": age})
    result["assumptions"].append("Volatility-normalized square-root grid is a house model; not complete Gann theory or a natural time cycle")
    return result
reference_note: Source principles and house thresholds are distinct; no claim to cover all interpretations.
learning_policy: Versioned observations, attributable closed outcomes and local chart-feature classifier evaluation; no automatic mutation of rules, risk or live votes.
